name: Alsóregmec (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alsóregmec: a crowned blue shield with a yellow winged horse and a green base, with a helm, blue and yellow mantling and a scroll inscribed ALSÓREGMEC.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Alsóregmec arms with crown, helm, mantling and scroll
